metadata.name: Christian Democracy
metadata.description: German Christian democracy combining personal dignity, parliamentary democracy, a social market economy and federal subsidiarity.
metadata.period: CDU fundamental programme adopted May 2024; incumbent-government context through 4 October 2026
metadata.scope: German CDU Christian democracy as specified by its May 2024 fundamental programme, situated within the European personalist and social-market tradition. The programme is the primary source for current applications; EPP principles and Catholic social teaching explain its intellectual setting but do not override explicit CDU positions. Incumbent government acts are dated corroboration or counter-evidence, not automatic replacements for party doctrine. This is a sourced interpretation, not an adherent questionnaire. Unknown means the exact proposition is not established; neither equality nor social policy alone establishes a comparative biological-causation belief.
metadata.phrase: A democratic society combining personal dignity, social responsibility and a market economy, with decisions made close to the communities affected.

axes.brief: Revision 2 research currently supports 14 of 16 answers. democracy-autocracy-01: Elections confer public authority, not birth or expertise. democracy-autocracy-02: Expertise advises citizens but cannot replace their electoral mandate. democracy-autocracy-03: Equal personal dignity supports an inclusive adult franchise. democracy-autocracy-04: Executive authority remains subject to representative lawmaking. democracy-autocracy-05: Pluralism requires fair political competition. democracy-autocracy-06: Public responsibility requires opposition scrutiny of spending. democracy-autocracy-07: Constitutional legality needs courts able to restrain government. democracy-autocracy-08: Social partnership is not a trade-union monopoly on government. democracy-autocracy-09: Party exclusion requires independent constitutional procedure rather than leadership preference. democracy-autocracy-11: Subsidiarity and constitutional institutions reject sole personal authority. democracy-autocracy-12: Defined removal procedures protect accountable office. democracy-autocracy-13: Continuity cannot be a unilateral excuse to suspend elections. democracy-autocracy-15: Public office is entrusted and answerable. democracy-autocracy-16: Civilian constitutional rule precludes military self-authorisation. Unresolved: democracy-autocracy-10, democracy-autocracy-14.
axes.counterEvidence: The revision 1 answer set exceeded its evidence. Catholic anthropology and equal dignity do not establish comparative causal answers on Culture vs Nature. The cited Cambridge chapter was accessible as a summary, not its full text. The current German family-reunification suspension concerns subsidiary protection, not the quiz’s general route for migrants or permanent residents. EPP industrial innovation and responsible technology language does not establish particular neurotechnology, AI-diagnostics, gene-editing or risk-threshold answers. EPP/Catholic sources overlap but are not interchangeable; Catholic sexual doctrine alone cannot fix all current EPP family-policy positions. Unresolved question IDs: democracy-autocracy-10, democracy-autocracy-14.
